implementation.native_user_file_paths: All System81 std::fs fallback guards call host_filesystem_fallback_allowed; CPU profile refuses even an opting-in SysApi. Capability-aware SysApi operations remain available.
implementation.memory_metadata: macOS sysctlbyname(hw.memsize), host_statistics64, sysconf pagesize; Linux sysinfo; Windows GlobalMemoryStatusEx. No process launch or /proc file fallback in CPU metadata path.
implementation.calendar: Original local calendar and installed-clock timezone behavior unchanged; real local OS metadata remains trusted and nondeterministic.
implementation.cpu_record_scope: Original CPUID/RDTSC metadata measurement, including x86 one-second sample, remains trusted upstream code. No interpreter hot-loop/value/opcode rewrite.
implementation.diagnostics: Read-only visible_texts limited to 16 drawable text nodes × 256 Unicode characters, plus native text/render-tree counts.

checks: 9 real native System81 file selectors refuse a self-authored ambient sentinel despite SysApi opting in; no outside temporary writable probe created
Actual kernel metadata query returned nonzero total memory; available <= total
Real native GetLocalTime opcode writes valid current calendar fields, not zeros

limitations: This is a targeted audit of used native-host seams, not a claim that all transitive code is unsafe-free.
Only macOS metadata behavior was executed; Linux/Windows implementations have no hardware or cross-compilation claim.
Calendar/local timezone and CPU/parallelism metadata are legitimate host observations, not deterministic VM save data.
A failed physical-memory OS query retains the original (0,0) native failure representation; the public metadata API exposes the underlying io::Result.
